Recall that π(pi) is defined as the ratio of the circumference of a circle to its diameter. That is, π = 22/7. This seems to contradict the fact that π is an irrational number. How would you resolve this contradiction?
questions.answer: There is no contradiction. Measurement is approximate. At least one of circumference (C) or diameter (d) is irrational, so π = C/d is not a ratio of two integers.

But, ∠DOA + ∠AOB = 180° (Linear pair)

questions.question: The side of a triangle is doubled. Find the percentage of area increase
questions.answer:
let a, b, c be the sides of the triangle. S₁ = s = (a+b+c)/2,
A₁ = √S₁(S₁ – a) (S₁ – b) (S₁ – c)
When the sides are doubled 2a, 2b, 2c, s₂ = 2s₁
A₂ = √S₂(S₂ – 2a) (S₂ – 2b) (S₂ – 2c)
Substitute S₂= 2S₁ in above equation
A₂= √2 S₁( 2S₁ – 2a ) ( 2S₁ – 2b) (2S₁ – 2C)
= 4 √S₁(S₁ – a) (S₁ – b) (S₁ – c)
= A₂= 4 A₁ = 4 × Area of original triangle
Hence percentage increase in area = (increase in area / original area) × 100 = (A₂ – A₁)/A₁ × 100
= (A₂/A₁ – 1) × 100 = (4 – 1) × 100 = 300%
